---
description: "Styling and dark-mode rules for tooloogle web-component tools."
applyTo: "src/**/*.{css,ts}"
---
- Never hand-edit `*.css.ts` — auto-generated by `npm run css` and gitignored.
- After changing a `.css` file OR inline Tailwind classes in a `.ts` template, the dev watcher regenerates `.css.ts`; do not build manually.
- Dark mode is class-based: pair every light utility with a `dark:` variant (e.g. `bg-white dark:bg-gray-800`, `text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100`). A light bg with no `dark:bg`, or a dark bg with no base `dark:text-*`, is a bug.
- Prefer shared utilities from `src/_styles/*.css` (`btn*`, `form-*`, `card`, `card-muted`) over re-inlining surfaces.
